_note: Run: python3 bin/mutate.py --spec mutations/provider-support.json (standard-library only; no torch venv needed). provider_support.import_sibling is what a feature_provider calls to import its own sibling module (evaluate_linear, adapter, ...) so that a module of the same name already imported by ANOTHER method in the same interpreter does not shadow it -- the collision the locked CI matrix caught on the provider fan-out. These mutations prove its guards are not vacuous: a foreign method's cached module is actually dropped; the method directory is inserted at the FRONT of sys.path (not appended, where another method's dir would win); modules outside methods/ (stdlib, site-packages) are NEVER dropped; and a purged package takes its submodules with it so a relative import re-resolves.
